title: The Will of Windrow House
author: Dominic Delacroix
blurb: Silas Eastwick, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
